carried_forward_failures.reason: Prior normal USB/runtime failure retained; no new passing recovery in this follow-up.

excluded_host_workflows.scope: D-Bus workflow failure; not a clean BLE comparison. No BlueZ segfault cause is inferred.

minimal_usb_irq.interpretation: Priority 2/6/2 did not restore echo reliability. Rates are upper bounds on counts including probe traffic, not valid interrupt-duration measurements.

native_nordic_sdk.interpretation: The completed v11 same-image/policy comparison at actual 15 ms reproduced strict lifecycle FAIL/PASS/FAIL for active USB with serial queries, suspended USB and active USB without application serial I/O. All phases completed 90 echoes, but only suspension had three clean links. Earlier v9/v10 fast-interval 90-echo campaigns also retained initial-establishment/teardown failures. No reliable simultaneous-active-USB production fix or secure Companion qualification is demonstrated.

nordic-fast-v9-all-repeat.interpretation: Three 30-echo harness sessions completed with actual 7.5 ms intervals, but HCI records two LL Response Timeout disconnects 0x22, two failed-establishment attempts 0x3E and only one local-host close 0x16. Payload completion is not three clean-link passes. Independent lifecycle audit places the 0x22 completion after an explicit host Disconnect command; the capture does not establish payload-time link failure.

usb_concurrent_telemetry.scope: Returned USB rssi/link command-response telemetry. Counts are query responses, not USB packets. Response-completion timestamps establish repeated overlap with reported active BLE; this is not Full Companion USB qualification.

nordic-fast-v9-sleep.interpretation: One 30-echo diagnostic session completed after actual interval changed from 75 ms to 7.5 ms; HCI closed locally with 0x16. Concurrent USB queries remained functional. This is a diagnostic candidate, not production acceptance.

usb_concurrent_telemetry.scope: Returned USB rssi/link command-response telemetry. Counts are query responses, not USB packets. Response-completion timestamps establish repeated overlap with reported active BLE; this is not Full Companion USB qualification.

nordic-fast-v9-slow-control.counter_scope: Controller connection-complete events and peripheral SDK counters are separate observations. Their differences are preserved without assigning a cause.
nordic-fast-v9-slow-control.interpretation: Same v9 image observed a successful update from cached initial 7.5 ms to actual 75 ms before the service-discovery workflow failed, with zero echoes. HCI records four 0x3E and one 0x08, while the final peripheral readback still reports connected with SDK delta 1/0. No cause is assigned to that difference.

nordic-fast-v9-tx0-recovery.counter_scope: Controller connection-complete events and peripheral SDK counters are separate observations. Their differences are preserved without assigning a cause.
nordic-fast-v9-tx0-recovery.interpretation: At TX 0 dBm the legacy harness completed three sessions and 90 echoes, but strict lifecycle failed: eight initial-establishment failures, one 0x08, two 0x22 and one local-host close. HCI recorded twelve connection-complete events versus SDK connection/disconnect deltas 5/5.
nordic-fast-v9-tx0-recovery.summary_pass_semantics: Legacy session/payload harness without the later strict HCI lifecycle gate.

nordic-final-tx8-dcdc.interpretation: One 30-echo diagnostic session passed with HCI local-host disconnect 0x16; repeatability was not demonstrated.

nordic-final-tx8-dcdc-repeat.interpretation: Failed after two echoes; no HCI disconnect was captured, so link loss is not inferred from the harness timeout alone.

nordic-final-tx8-dcdc-slow.interpretation: Failed after nine echoes despite a ten-second echo deadline; HCI and peripheral both recorded connection timeout 0x08.

nordic-gatt-v10-quiet-fast.counter_scope: Controller connection-complete events and peripheral SDK counters are separate observations. Their differences are preserved without assigning a cause.
nordic-gatt-v10-quiet-fast.interpretation: Quiet GATT initiation completed three payload sessions and 90 echoes, but the new strict lifecycle gate correctly kept passed=false: five failed initial establishments, two 0x22 and one local-host close. HCI recorded eight connection-complete events versus SDK deltas 3/3. This does not demonstrate a reliable fix.

nordic-idle-v8-busy.interpretation: One 30-echo diagnostic session passed with HCI local-host disconnect 0x16; a busy-idle repeat failed, so this is not a reliable fix.

nordic-idle-v8-busy-repeat.interpretation: Failed after twelve echoes despite a ten-second echo deadline; HCI and peripheral both recorded connection timeout 0x08.

nordic-idle-v8-sleep.interpretation: Sleep-idle diagnostic completed zero echoes; the host observed connection timeout 0x08 before a passing session.

nordic-link-default-long-connect.interpretation: Thirty echoes completed and harness reported passed, but matching HCI recorded LL Response Timeout 0x22; not a clean-link or reliable-fix acceptance. Independent lifecycle audit places the 0x22 completion after an explicit host Disconnect command; the capture does not establish payload-time link failure.

nordic-link-phy1m-ch37.interpretation: Thirty echoes completed and harness reported passed, but matching HCI recorded LL Response Timeout 0x22; not a clean-link or reliable-fix acceptance. Independent lifecycle audit places the 0x22 completion after an explicit host Disconnect command; the capture does not establish payload-time link failure.

nordic-phone-v11-active.interpretation: Active USB with concurrent serial telemetry completed 90 echoes at actual 15 ms, but strict lifecycle failed: two initial-establishment failures, two 0x22 and one local-host close; median RTT 452.834 ms.

nordic-phone-v11-active-idle.interpretation: Same phone-interval policy with no application USB serial I/O during BLE still completed 90 echoes but failed strict lifecycle: two initial-establishment failures, one 0x22 and two local-host closes. This does not imply an electrically quiet USB bus.

nordic-phone-v11-suspended.interpretation: With the same runtime build and phone-interval configuration, observed USB runtime suspension produced three clean diagnostic links and 90 echoes, with median RTT 33.671 ms. This adds no secure Companion qualification or simultaneous-active-USB pass.

strict_classifier.scope: Pure offline classification of locked exact-peer captures; requires expected connection count and only clean local/remote-user disconnect reasons, with no failed establishments.

native_nordic_sdk.scope: SDK 17.1 / S140 7.3.0 public DIS/NUS nonce-echo diagnostics; no secure Companion acceptance is claimed. Build identifiers and test-source digests remain bound to each trial.

v11_active_suspend_active_comparison.interpretation: Same-image/policy active-suspended-active comparison strengthens active USB as the discriminator. Failure persisted without application USB serial I/O; USB application payload traffic alone is not required to reproduce it. This does not isolate an electrical, RF, peripheral or host implementation cause, and is not a production fix.

v9_lifecycle_audit.interpretation: A redundant-update guard is a reasonable isolation control. These captures establish correlation with teardown completion delays; they do not reveal the exact air-side LL procedure or prove that the earlier same-parameter request caused 0x22.

normal_full_restoration.scope: Application restoration and finite USB runtime smoke only. Transition-time probe failures remain recorded separately. Historical Full42 qualification stays source-bound; no new BLE, RF, full USB campaign or complete-feature qualification at Full72 is claimed.

active_usb_firmware_isolation.scope: Completed current-turn safe reports only. Payload completion, strict controller lifecycle and peripheral SDK counters are separate observations. V11 controlled active/suspended/active results are measured. Unmodified normal Full72 is restored and verified by USB runtime smoke only; historical Full42 qualification remains source-bound.

A BlueZ cached target object was absent; no direct attempt was armed.

controlled_bluetooth_restart_and_immedia.interpretation: Intermittent bidirectional link reaches pairing, then times out; no stable Companion BLE pass or explicit PIN rejection.

four_second_initial_timeout_comparison.limitation: Central connection events report locally selected parameters; they do not prove T1000 receipt of CONNECT_IND. The T1000 failed initial establishment (0x3E), so this does not measure pairing on an established four-second link.

pi_live_update_attempt.initial_host_setup_failure: Linux HCI filter padding corrected before the valid trial; no connection update was issued by the failed setup.

independent_central_comparison.interpretation: Two central implementations failed before usable T1000 ATT. Component, bootloader cause and hardware defect remain unproven.

minimal_ble_isolation_v2.conclusion: Neither minimal application produced a usable BLE link. Stable watchdog feeding removes the earlier LFRC reset confound. This does not isolate common framework/SoftDevice, the high-frequency RF clock, power or RF hardware.

physical_battery_only_ble.conclusion: Normal Full firmware passed fresh PIN pairing and three bonded reconnects on battery. Reconnecting USB reproduced discovery and connection failures with the same saved bond and firmware. This identifies an operating-condition association, not a specific hardware, power or USB-software root cause.

usb_autosuspend_handoff.conclusion: Each USB open autoresumed the device and passed read-only Companion queries. After close, the device suspended and a 30-second secure BLE session passed. This verifies sequential handoffs as a possible host workaround, not simultaneous active-USB/BLE operation or a production firmware fix. The original active USB policy was restored after testing.
usb_autosuspend_handoff.method: Two-second per-device USB autosuspend; three USB-open/close/BLE cycles

usb_configuration_comparison.conclusion: No stable Companion session before, during or after USB deauthorization. The deauthorized trial briefly encrypted, then timed out. Configuration removal is not physical USB disconnection and does not eliminate USB bus signalling or prove the peripheral USB block stopped. Exact USB authorization was restored; after host device-node permissions settled, a separate normal-user runtime read verified unchanged Full firmware, public identity and advancing uptime.
